name: Lemonade Chat Model
category_description: AI cluster sub-node (model, memory, tool, parser)
description: Use the Lemonade Chat Model node to run chat-capable language models managed by a Lemonade server from within n8n. This node functions as a LangChain-compatible chat model root node and is suitable for chat-style workloads. It lets you select a model hosted on your Lemonade server, and control generation behavior using common sampling and decoding options

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: The model which will generate the completion. Models are loaded and managed through the Lemonade server. This parameter is required. Select the model name made available by your Lemonade server (for example, a model alias like "gpt-4", or any custom model name exposed by Lemonade)

parameters.name: Sampling Temperature
parameters.description: Controls the randomness of the generated text. Lower values make the output more focused and deterministic, while higher values make it more diverse and random

parameters.name: Top P
parameters.description: Controls which words the model can choose from when generating text. Lower values progressively remove the least likely options, so the model can only pick from a smaller, higher-confidence pool

parameters.name: Frequency Penalty
parameters.description: Adjusts the penalty for tokens that have already appeared in the generated text. Positive values discourage repetition, negative values encourage it

parameters.name: Presence Penalty
parameters.description: Adjusts the penalty for tokens based on their presence in the generated text so far. Positive values penalize tokens that have already appeared, encouraging diversity

parameters.name: Max Tokens to Generate
parameters.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate. Set to -1 for no limit. Be cautious when setting this to a large value, as it can lead to long outputs

parameters.name: Stop Sequences
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of sequences where the model will stop generating text. Use this to define explicit termination strings for responses

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: This node must be connected to an AI chain. Insert one
